4b6dd1e63f.q: What is High TQ and why does it matter more than expertise according to John Patterson?
4b6dd1e63f.a: High TQ is the capacity to navigate transactions successfully with precision, accuracy, and completeness. According to Patterson, while expertise is being commoditized by AI, how you transact is not. High TQ represents the ability to make exchanges precise, accurate, and complete in whatever register the exchange requires—sometimes warm, sometimes hard, cold, and consequential—enabling professionals to produce the outcomes they actually want rather than repeating unintended results.

5d1075b145.q: What is the key question John Patterson asks professionals to reveal the gap in transactional intelligence?
5d1075b145.a: Patterson asks: "What did you actually agree to?" This question—focusing on what was actually agreed to, not what was intended, assumed, or implied—consistently reveals what he calls the hidden intelligence behind human exchanges. The pause that follows this question is what motivated writing the book, as most professionals struggle to identify the incomplete agreements that drive repeated unwanted outcomes.

It reveals your personality in transaction—how you tend to move when something consequential is on the line—and where you land on the high-low TQ spectrum. It is not a test with anything to pass; most people find it uncomfortably accurate.
